text: Dove is committed to real beauty and self-confidence. Our tone is warm and caring, emphasizing natural and authentic visuals.
Visual style: Natural photography with soft whites and blues. Target audience: Women of all ages seeking inclusivity and empowerment.
Brand values: Real beauty, self-confidence, inclusivity. Messaging: Positive and uplifting, showing real people in everyday situations.
Axe is bold and confident. Our tone is playful and energetic, targeting young men with humor and swagger.
Visual style: Dynamic and edgy with dark colors and high contrast. Target audience: Young men aged 18-30 seeking confidence and attraction.
Brand values: Confidence, attraction, boldness. Messaging: Fun and provocative, showing active lifestyles and social situations.
Lipton brings natural refreshment and wellness. Our tone is friendly and refreshing, emphasizing natural ingredients.
Visual style: Bright and natural with greens and yellows. Target audience: Health-conscious consumers seeking natural refreshment.
Brand values: Natural wellness, refreshment, sustainability. Messaging: Fresh and inviting, showing outdoor scenes and natural settings.
